The repaired acme/widgets#77 criterion now matches the existing path: settings/resolver.ts:12 owns the defaults, and ui/report-view.ts:30 consumes the resolved settings. I'm treating that row as `in-scope` with no deviation, and I'll record that in the draft with the repaired ticket as the source.

When someone switches workspaces, what should happen to the report filters that are currently active?
A) Reset every filter to the resolver's default on each workspace change. The new workspace always opens unfiltered, or with the configured default filters.
B) Remember filters separately for each workspace, keyed by workspace id. Switching back restores that workspace's last filters.
C) Keep the active filters, but drop any filter whose values do not exist in the new workspace. Filters that still match stay applied.
D) Other - name it.
Recommendation: A - It directly stops filters from hiding rows in the new workspace. It also keeps the resolver as the only source of defaults and adds no per-workspace state beside it.
